title: Story premise EDU054: The Task That Waited on Tomorrow
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (work/process). Hook: Can this step start before its input exists? Takeaway/theme: Dependencies constrain which work can start and when.
description: A team wants to finish a demo Friday, but schedules the sound mix before the narration is approved. A dependency graph makes the impossible order visible and moves approval ahead of the mix.
